limitations: A textual speaker label is not a resolved external referent.
Source interpretation and complete semantic translation remain declared premises.
No nested quotation, general conditional parsing, ordinary free prose, or assertion of event truth.
Preserving a scoped body is distinct from obtaining a complete A116 representation of that body.
